name: Limited two-way rotary-motion qualifier
aliases: Limited two-way rotary-motion qualifier IEC reference
summary: This qualifier identifies rotary movement in both directions over a limited travel.
description: This qualifier identifies rotary movement in both directions over a limited travel. A mechanism can move clockwise and counterclockwise between defined positions without rotating indefinitely. This distinction is useful for actuators and position-changing mechanisms.
State the end positions or stops in the mechanism documentation. The qualifier itself supplies neither angular travel nor the electrical control sequence.
readingNotes: Record the mechanism's defined end positions separately.
A limited-travel qualifier gives no numerical angular range.
drawingChecklist: Identify the associated device, circuit or diagram boundary.
